invented.quote: Every one of those that is one of the 20 generics now costs us money to fill.
invented.why: The brief states that the plan pays on average $1.80 less than cost across the 20 generic drugs, not that every single prescription among those 20 drugs loses money.

invented.quote: We have filled prescriptions for your members for years
invented.why: The brief only gives prescription data for last year and since January, and does not state that the pharmacies have filled prescriptions for plan members for years.
